title: Factorized channel × timescale Mirror SSM
hypothesis: A task code over shared channel and timescale factors can represent many selective transition tables with less serialized state than independent SSM rates; private residual factors reveal when the logical recurrence family needs task-specific parameters.
physical_object: Shared channel and timescale transition factors for a diagonal state-space model
mirror_coordinate: Per-task CP coefficients over shared channel × timescale outer-product modes, plus optional private residual factors
logical_multiplicity: 16/64 task-specific logical recurrence tables over 8 channels × 8 timescales

task.metric: Held-out sequence output NRMSE, actual complete serialized inference bytes, parameter-generation MAC proxy, recurrent update MAC proxy

development.selection_metric: Quality/storage/generator-compute frontier; exact native CP alias falsifies Mirror-specific claim

controls: Native shared rank-4 CP channel × timescale factorization
Mirror-coded shared rank-4 CP recurrence with identical decoder
Native shared CP plus private per-task rank-r residual SVD factors
Mirror shared CP plus the same private residual factors

paid_objects: all task transition rates or shared channel/timescale factors

success_gate: At residual 0 and task counts 16/64, Mirror mean output NRMSE <=0.02 and complete payload <=50% of full tables. For nonzero residual, at least one private residual rank must meet output NRMSE <= full-model output NRMSE + 0.02 and <=75% full bytes. Mirror must strictly beat the corresponding native CP control in quality, bytes, or compute without losing another Pareto axis.
failure_gate: Mirror misses quality/storage gate or exactly aliases native CP and native CP+private controls. Exact development alias permits fresh to remain sealed.
boundaries: Synthetic diagonal SSM with task-specific transition tables; not a Mamba or language-model reproduction
Transition rate is transformed through softplus before recurrence to ensure stability
All task codes, basis factors, residual state, readout and metadata are serialized and charged
Address count is not treated as logical capacity; only measured sequence quality is credited
Fresh worlds cannot alter CP rank, residual rank, or score
